faq.q: What is included in the Marbella family boat day 2036 combo?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The combo adds a jetski (free on Mangusta 80), snorkel gear, and a paddleboard. You can request these extras for any boat in our fleet.

faq.q: How much does the family boat day cost?
faq.a: For boats like Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, prices start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) costs €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and includes a jetski. For other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. Our standard package already includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There is no corkage fee, and the crew will help with storage and serving.

faq.q: What snorkel spots do you recommend near Marbella?
faq.a: Popular spots include Cala del Faro (rocky coves with clear water), Cala Cortés (sheltered bay), and Cabopino (secluded beach). The skipper will choose the best location based on sea conditions and your preferences.

faq.q: Is the paddleboard suitable for children?
faq.a: Absolutely. Paddleboards are stable and easy to use. Life jackets are provided for all ages, and the skipper can give basic instructions. Many families enjoy paddling along the coast near Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How long does a family boat day typically last?
faq.a: Most families book a half-day (4 hours) or full-day (8 hours). A 2-hour trip is also available for a quick spin. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking. You can customise the itinerary with the skipper.

faq.q: Do we need a licence to drive the jetski?
faq.a: No, you do not need a licence. The jetski is operated under the supervision of our licensed skipper. Safety briefings and life jackets are provided. The Mangusta 80 includes a jetski free of charge.

faq.q: What boats are best for a family group of 10?
faq.a: The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) and Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offer plenty of space. The Lagoon 380 catamaran (11.6m, 10 pax) is also great for stability. All depart from Puerto Banús.

data.body_html:
Plan the perfect Marbella family boat day 2036 with a jetski, snorkel, and paddleboard combo. Depart from Puerto Banús and enjoy a full day of water fun, sun, and luxury. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, including a licensed skipper, drinks, and VAT. Whether you choose a sleek Astondoa 40 or a spacious Mangusta 80, every charter comes with toys for all ages. Book your family adventure today.

Why Choose Our Marbella Family Boat Day Combo?

Our combo is designed for families who want variety without the hassle. Every charter includes a jetski (free on the Mangusta 80), snorkel gear, and a paddleboard. The skipper handles navigation, so you can focus on fun. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina, with easy access to calm coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés.

Our Fleet for Family Charters

We offer a range of boats to suit your group size and budget. All are maintained to high standards and include safety equipment for children.

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h, ideal for small families.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h, spacious and comfortable.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h, includes free jetski.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request.
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) – stable catamaran, great for kids.
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – ultimate luxury for larger groups.

For pricing on any boat not listed above, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)
  • Jetski, snorkel gear, and paddleboard (on this combo)

You can also bring your own food and drinks – no corkage fee.

Sample Itinerary for a 4-Hour Family Boat Day

Your skipper will tailor the route, but here's a typical plan:

  • 10:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your yacht.
  • 10:15 – Safety briefing and departure towards Cabopino.
  • 10:45 – First snorkel stop at Cala del Faro (30 min).
  • 11:30 – Jetski session in open water (20 min per person).
  • 12:15 – Paddleboard along the coast near Río Verde.
  • 13:00 – Lunch and drinks on board while anchored.
  • 14:00 – Return to Puerto Banús.

Best Snorkel and Paddleboard Spots

Marbella's coastline offers several family-friendly locations:

  • Cala del Faro – Rocky coves with clear water, ideal for snorkelling.
  • Cala Cortés – Sheltered bay with calm conditions for paddleboarding.
  • Cabopino – Secluded beach with shallow waters for kids.
  • Estepona – Slightly further, but offers vibrant marine life.

The skipper will choose the best spot based on weather and sea state.
